00028 /**
00029  * @brief               Put the storage in writable mode
00030  *
00031  * This function puts the storage specified with the index in writable mode.
00032  * Any application has to call this function prior to writing on the mounted storage.
00033  * Otherwise the attempt to write would usually fail because the system usually
00034  * put the media in read-only mode to protect it from the filesystem corruption by
00035  * accidental eject. 
00036  *
00037  * @param index         IN:    Index for the storage
00038  *
00039  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  
00040  *
00041  **/
00042 HxResult HxStorageBeginWrite(int index);
00043 
00044 /**
00045  * @brief               Remove the storage from writable mode
00046  *
00047  * This function informs the system that the storage can go back into read-only
00048  * mode. The application who has finished write operations should immediately call 
00049  * this function. If multiple applications have called HxStorageBeginWrite,
00050  * the storage is not going back to read-only mode until the last application calls 
00051  * HxStorageEndWrite.
00052  *
00053  * @param index         IN:    Index for the storage
00054  *
00055  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  
00056  *
00057  **/
00058 HxResult HxStorageEndWrite(int index);
00059 
00060 /**

00065  * it is mounted (e.g. formatting)

00072 HxResult HxStorageUnmountVolume(int index);
